notes: SHIP v1.14.376 - SHIP 6 SLICE 2. The 35 unscoped CSS rules from the N-11 residue, cut to 21 by a working emitter check plus the semantic sort. THE EMITTER CHECK WAS REBUILT FIRST, BECAUSE THE PREVIOUS ONE LIED: the .375 session's check returned em=0 for all 35 rules - a broken regex whose quote-escaping collapsed inside a nested shell string, NOT 35 dead rules. The rebuilt check tokenises every class attribute in the file into a count map instead of running a regex per class, and was sanity-checked against known answers (tile=4, dl-chip=9, rd-row=0 - that last one matching Ship 5's finding that the .rd- family is dead). ACKNOWLEDGED LIMIT OF THAT CHECK, AND IT CHANGED THE FENCE: it proves LIVE reliably but CANNOT prove DEAD for classes toggled at runtime via classList.add - is-blocked reads 0 while its sibling is-done reads 1, which is an artifact of the instrument, not a dead rule. So every is-blocked/is-blk/pp-seal sibling was treated as LIVE and swept WITH its family; leaving them behind would have half-painted each family exactly the way .373's press states nearly were. SHIPPED, 21 rules across four families: .pp-* phase-progress (L8421 fill, L8423 is-blk fill, L8427/L8431 node dots, L8433 seal dot, L8436/L8438 stats, L8441 the pp-pulse-r keyframe) - .trace-* (L8449/L8451 nodes, L8455 label) - #ph-dock .phd-chip (L9264/L9265 is-done, L9266/L9267/L9268 is-blocked) - .bp-* complete family (L9731 card-status, L9747 bar-fill, L9820 item-counts, L9843 item-status, L9974 status-btn). L9731 is the one flagged during the .373 audit as semantically the COMPLETE channel that should have been teal all along.
